inlines.v: EFFU'SE, verb transitive effu'ze. [Latin effusus, from effundo; ex and fundo, to pour.] To pour out as a fluid; so spill; to shed. With gushing blood effused. EFFU'SE, adjective Dissipated; profuse. [Not in used.]
